title: Launchpad OEE (AU) (dev)
description: Australian port of the Inductive Automation Launchpad OEE example. Seven simulated lines with OEE per hour, shift and day, metric units, and a 3 x 8h roster (22-06, 06-14, 14-22). Tags live flat under [Launchpad]OEE/. Requires the gateway scripting project to be set to this project.
